narrative_events.details: Vyāsa asks priorbirth, worship/grants, Gaṇeśa realm and śamī origins.
Brahmā calls hunter former righteous king; character, army, two wise ministers, merciful wife and good rule; deathbed1000cows/18great gifts.

Childless king dies; wife follows; funerals/11thdaygifts; month later consult and crown nominated kin heir Sāmba. Vyāsa query discloses hidden fisherman parentage through Durdharṣa wife, distinct social paternity.
Regalia/treasury conveyed, ministers retained; king abuses/confiscates/expels, disregards counsel and imprisons repeated advisers.
Parents appeal on advisers’ favor; king chains parents too, appoints evil friend Duṣṭabuddhi, lavishes goods/servants and threatens death for disobedience.
Pair force women/property without kinship limits, kill brāhmaṇas/women/children and become shunned; hunt forest and send game to city.
Parenthetic Varada founding: father ten-syllable tapas, Ganesh appearance/desire grants, Vasiṣṭha installation/naming and fouraim promise; four sons born.
Hunting pair dismount, offer leaves/flowers, bow/circle briefly; their sole narrated merit. Die after evil reign.
Messengers bind dead pair; judge asks account, punishment order, then acknowledges small worshipmerit and predicts Gaṇeśa rescue after hell/basebirths.

Twenty-one hells and specified torments; command/execution durations retained unreconciled. Ordered paired species births finally demon/hunter, designated Piṅgākṣa/Durbuddhi; exact individual mapping unresolved.
Prior incidental worship has immeasurable merit; later Bhīma/demon tree encounter/śamī offering brings divine bodies/svarloka. Brahmā announces Vāmana installation/tapas next.
